list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A dinuclear ytterbocene methylthiolate with two bridging SMe ligands forming a Yb2S2 unit.

synthesis.procedure: Under purified nitrogen using Schlenk techniques, MeLi was added to the ytterbocene chloride solution in toluene at −30 °C. After 1 h at low temperature, the mixture was warmed to ambient temperature and LiCl was removed by centrifugation. S8 was added, the mixture was stirred for 10 h, and solvent was removed under reduced pressure.
synthesis.temperature: −30 °C initially; ambient temperature for sulfur reaction; −15 °C for recrystallization
synthesis.time: 1 h before sulfur addition; 10 h after sulfur addition
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Concentrated under reduced pressure to a yellow powder; recrystallized from THF/hexane at −15 °C to obtain orange-red crystals.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Reported as the dinuclear yttrium methylthiolate analogue [Cp2Y(μ-SMe)]2; unlike 1a, it was not characterized crystallographically in this article.

synthesis.procedure: Under nitrogen, MeLi was added to bridged yttrium cyclopentadienyl chloride in toluene at −30 °C. The mixture was stirred for 1 h at low temperature, warmed to ambient temperature, treated with S8, and stirred for 10 h. The precipitate was removed by centrifugation.
synthesis.time: 1 h before sulfur addition; 10 h after sulfur addition
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Concentrated to about 4 mL; the precipitated colorless solid was collected, washed twice with hexane, and vacuum-dried.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A crystallographically characterized dinuclear yttrium n-butylthiolate with bridging thiolate sulfur atoms forming a Y2S2 unit.

synthesis.procedure: Under nitrogen, n-BuLi was added to the yttrium chloride precursor in toluene at −30 °C. After 3 h, S8 was added at −5 °C. The mixture was stirred for 5 h at low temperature, then warmed to ambient temperature and stirred overnight. The precipitate was removed by centrifugation.
synthesis.temperature: −30 °C for n-BuLi addition; −5 °C for sulfur addition; then ambient temperature; −15 °C for recrystallization
synthesis.time: 3 h before sulfur addition; 5 h at low temperature after addition; then overnight
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Concentrated to about 6 mL to precipitate a colorless solid; recrystallized from toluene/THF at −15 °C.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A centrosymmetric square-planar tetrayttrium cluster with a planar Y4S2 bridging unit. Each sulfide bridges three Y atoms; two Y atoms also bind a THF oxygen atom.

synthesis.procedure: Under nitrogen, n-BuLi was added to the yttrium chloride precursor in toluene at −30 °C. After 30 min at low temperature, the solution was warmed to room temperature and stirred for 3 h. S8 was added at ambient temperature and the mixture stirred for 12 h. A precipitate was removed by centrifugation and the solvent removed.
synthesis.time: 30 min at low temperature; 3 h at room temperature before sulfur addition; 12 h after sulfur addition
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Solvent removal gave a white solid; diffusion of hexane into a THF solution afforded pale yellow crystals.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The crystallographically characterized ytterbium analogue of 2a: a square-planar tetranuclear sulfide cluster in which each sulfide bridges three Yb atoms.

synthesis.procedure: Under nitrogen, S8 was added to a THF solution of [Cp2Yb(μ-SEt)]2. The mixture was stirred for 3 h; crystals of 2b and 3 formed over the following days at room temperature and were separated by selecting individual large crystals.
synthesis.time: 3 h stirring; crystallization over several days
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Red crystals were separated from the accompanying dark green crystals of 3 by picking large crystals.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A dinuclear ytterbocene complex with an η2:η2-bridging disulfide group. Each Yb binds two cyclopentadienyl groups, both bridging sulfur atoms, and one THF oxygen atom.

synthesis.procedure: Under nitrogen, S8 was added to a THF solution of [Cp2Yb(μ-SEt)]2. The mixture was stirred for 3 h; crystals of 3 and 2b formed over the following days at room temperature and were separated by selecting individual large crystals.
synthesis.time: 3 h stirring; crystallization over several days
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Dark green crystals were separated from the accompanying red crystals of 2b by picking large crystals.
